gloss: this kind of; like this; such

definitions.gloss: this kind of; like this; such
definitions.explanation: A demonstrative expression that refers to something near the speaker or just mentioned, used to modify a noun as 'this type of' or 'this sort of.'

examples.japanese: こういう{時|とき}はどう⟦すれば→する：00392_suru⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧？
examples.english: What should I do at a time like this?

examples.japanese: こういう⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{初|はじ}めて→初めて：02932_hajimete⟧⟦{聞|き}いた→聞く：00483_kiku⟧。
examples.english: This is the first time I've heard this kind of story.

examples.japanese: こういう⟦{細|こま}かい→細かい：01245_komakai⟧⟦ところ→ところ：01137_tokoro⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{気|き}→気：02199_ki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{配|くば}れる→配る：03921_kubaru⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{信頼|しんらい}される→信頼する：22988_shinraisuru⟧。
examples.english: People who pay attention to small details like this earn trust.

notes:
A demonstrative expression meaning "this kind of" or "like this," referring to something near the speaker or just mentioned. It is the colloquial equivalent of ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧ような.

USAGE:
- Always modifies a noun: こういう + noun
- Used in everyday conversation; ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧ような is the more formal equivalent
- Part of the こ/そ/あ/ど demonstrative series: こういう (this kind), ⟦そういう→そういう：09579_souiu⟧ (that kind), ⟦ああいう→ああいう：16591_aaiu⟧ (that kind, distant), ⟦どういう→どういう：28147_douiu⟧ (what kind)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- こういう⟦{場合|ばあい}→場合：01704_baai⟧: in this kind of case
- こういう{時|とき}: at a time like this
- こういうこと: this kind of thing
- こういう⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧: this type of person
- こういうもの: things like this

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦そういう→そういう：09579_souiu⟧: that kind of (referring to something the listener mentioned)
- ⟦ああいう→ああいう：16591_aaiu⟧: that kind of (referring to something distant or previously observed)
- ⟦どういう→どういう：28147_douiu⟧: what kind of (question form)
- ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧ような: this kind of (more formal equivalent)
